challenge.method: Compare the libiberty grant against both comments in historical libgcc1.c. Identify what is compiled, what is linked and the stated consequence.
challenge.results: In libiberty the compiler condition modifies the files linked with the library. The historical first paragraph grants permission to link the compiled file with other programs and distribute them. The later libgcc1.c comment is the close alternative witness, using “GCC” where libiberty uses “a GNU compiler.” The first paragraph and the GNU Compiler Exception therefore have distinct identities.
